class.name: PlayerLook
class.brief_description: Class to process player input for aiming.
class.description: This [Node3D] rotates based on mouse input. This input is scaled by [code]Globals.sensitivity[/code].

argument.name: delta
argument.description: Rotates the [Node3D] base by the mouse input. Checks if the Input Action [code]Mouse_Released[/code] is pressed, and if so, sets [enum Input.MouseMode] to [code]MOUSE_MODE_VISIBLE[/code].

argument.name: event
argument.description: Checks if [param event] is a [InputEventMouseMotion] and if so scales the input by [param Globals.sensitivity]

method.name: print_type
method.description: Print the type of the variant.
